lines: Cyrus Jamshed Guzder is an investor selling shareholder, offering up to 132,000 shares in the offer for sale, with proceeds of up to ₹17.85 crore if all offered shares are sold.
Potential gain is up to ₹13.36 crore before offer expenses and taxes; employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
The sale is timed at listing, with trading start printed as March 11, 2026, which makes this a timely moment to reach out. No shares are retained.
Confidence is medium: the name is verified in the seller table, but holdings appear in one section only (promoter_holding).
